newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean feed millers pass on feedgrains tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean feed millers pass on feedgrains tenders.

text.p: Nine South Korean feed mill companies, including Sunjin Feed Co Ltd and Je Il Feed Co Ltd, passed on tenders for 52,500 tonnes of corn and 52,000 tonnes of feed wheat due to high prices, traders said on Wednesday.
Delivery of the corn was set for July 25 and the wheat delivery was set for January 10, changed from the original January 25 wheat delivery. Arrival was set for Inchon and Kunsan.
The lowest bid for corn was made by Cargill at $154.73 per tonne, C&F, and Hyundai Corp offered the lowest bid for corn or wheat, at $153.85 or $151.85, at the seller's option.
